surface_verification.justification: Pure Python config-reader migration in shared/scripts/{lib,tools}; no startable web/dev-server/CLI surface of its own -- verification is shared/tests (10144) + shared/scripts/tools/tests (810) + integration-tests (534), plus an empirical CLI dry-run of convert_configs_to_events.py's actual entry point.

behaviors.behavior: all three consumers (design_checks.py, compliance_compliance.py, convert_configs_to_events.py) read phase_tasks[] as their primary progress signal via the shared completed_phases_with_fallback
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_handoff_phase_status_fallback.py::test_prefers_phase_tasks_over_stale_completed_steps PASSED (plus consumer-level equivalents in test_verifiers_design.py, test_workflow_checks.py, test_convert_configs_to_events.py)

behaviors.behavior: the adopted-repo (post s2/s2b) design-skip gate fires from phase_tasks[] alone, without reading completed_steps
a terminal design phase_tasks[] entry (design actually ran) still fails loud when the manifest is missing -- real drift, not a structural skip
a driven run mid-flight (phase_tasks[] present, nothing terminal yet) trusts its own EMPTY completed set and never falls back to a disagreeing, stale completed_steps
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_handoff_phase_status_fallback.py::test_trusts_an_empty_completed_set_when_phase_tasks_is_present, test_trusts_an_explicitly_empty_phase_tasks_list PASSED (plus per-consumer regression tests in design_checks/compliance_compliance/convert_configs_to_events suites)

behaviors.behavior: a phase_tasks[] entry terminalized as skipped counts as completed, matching completed_steps' pre-migration semantics (a standalone-skipped phase was already listed there like one that ran)
the completed_steps fallback fires ONLY when phase_tasks is absent or not a list -- never merely because nothing has finished yet
a legacy completed_steps list containing an unhashable entry (stray dict/list) is skipped rather than crashing the fallback
a standalone/v1-only config (no phase_tasks[] at all) still reads completed_steps correctly for all three consumers
convert_configs_to_events.py's shared-lib import resolves in its real CLI invocation (uv run ... --dry-run), not only under pytest
behaviors.evidence: empirical probe: `uv run shared/scripts/tools/convert_configs_to_events.py --project-root <fixture> --dry-run` against a hand-built phase_tasks[]+stale-completed_steps config produced the phase_tasks[]-derived events, run 2026-09-10 during this iterate
